Exact 16:9 wide canvas, absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, labels, UI, or readable marks anywhere. Arrange a central catalog monolith of modular paper and ceramic skill cards feeding a compact teal routing hub; the hub fans into selected card groups in separate orderly shelves for shared root and native shelves. Show a quiet circular lifecycle loop beside it: unused cards settle in a distinct geometric quarantine tray and can return; two legacy cards slide into a clean archive slot. Add only a thin amber side branch representing optional tools, never the main path. Palette: paper #F7F9F5 background, ink #12231E, teal #137E73 main accents, amber #AC6415 only on optional branch; soft daylight, generous negative space, crisp architectural geometry, tactile paper texture, low shadows, premium restrained editorial product art, no people, no fantasy, no terminal screenshot, no decorative typography. Ensure every surface is abstract and text-free.
